blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Manim supports precise, programmatic video generation, but a successfully rendered educational animation can still have visual defects, missing explanations, or incorrect content. Rendering does not directly identify the code changes needed to correct these visual failures, so feedback-driven revision is needed. Existing agentic frameworks use iterative rendering and revision but typically rely on large models, often proprietary. Existing Manim datasets primarily contain final programs and often lack quality verification and the trajectories of feedback and revisions needed to learn this refinement process. We introduce ManimData and ManimCode, a data and training framework for feedback-driven educational animation generation. We construct ManimData through a render-guided pipeline that iteratively generates, executes, reviews, and revises Manim programs with retrieved API documentation. Its 24,034 render-verified, quality-filtered records preserve intermediate programs, execution errors, visual critiques, and corrective revisions. We use role-conditioned supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories to train ManimCode, a single 4B model, to write, review, and revise animation programs. To improve correction of errors that differ from those in the collected trajectories, we then train the Reviser with reinforcement learning on self-generated states, using rendering outcomes and reference-free quality feedback. ManimCode achieves 96.6% and 97.0% render success on ManimData-test and ManimBench, compared with 52.6% and 82.0% for the untrained 4B model under the same inference setup, while also improving video quality scores from 2.48 to 2.94 and from 3.00 to 3.44. Integrating ManimCode into two long-form educational video generation systems increases completed videos from 19/117 to 107/117 and from 53/239 to 239/239, alongside improvements in educational effectiveness and visual quality.
blocks.zh: 马尼姆支持精确的,程序化的视频生成,但成功制作的教育动画仍然可能存在视觉缺陷,缺少解释,或内容不正确. 渲染不直接识别纠正这些视觉故障所需的代码修改,因此需要反馈驱动的修订. 现有的代理框架使用迭代渲染和修订,但一般依赖大型模型,往往是专有的. 现有的Manim数据集主要包含最终程序,往往缺乏质量核实以及学习这一完善过程所需的反馈和修改的轨迹. 我们介绍了ManimData和ManimCode,这是供反馈驱动的教育动画制作的数据和培训框架。 我们通过一个渲染导管构建了ManimData,该管道可以迭代生成,执行,审查和修改Manim程序,并使用检索的API文档. 它的24,034个经过校验、质量过滤的记录保存了中间程序、执行错误、视觉批评和修正。 我们利用这些轨迹上的角色条件监督微调来训练ManimCode, 一个单一的4B模型, 编写,审查和修改动画程序. 为了更好地纠正与所收集的轨迹不同的错误,我们然后对审校进行关于自我生成状态的强化学习,使用渲染结果和无参考质量反馈。 马尼姆 在ManimData测试和Manim Bench上,代码达到96.6%和97.0%,而在同一推论设置下,未经培训的4B模型则达到52.6%和82.0%,同时,视频质量分数也从2.48提高到2.94,从3.00提高到3.44。 将ManimCode纳入两个长式教育录像制作系统,完成的录像从19/117增加到107/117,从53/239增加到239/239,同时提高教育质量和视觉质量。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Educational animations help explain abstract STEM concepts by showing mathematical relationships, geometric constructions, and processes that unfold over time. Creating these animations by hand, however, requires both subject knowledge and programming expertise. Recent work uses language models to write programs for animation engines such as Manim, which render them into videos ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Ku et al., 2025 ) . This approach offers precise control over formulas, text, and geometry, which are difficult to maintain with pixel-space video generation. A successful render can still produce a poor teaching video: labels may overlap, objects may fall outside the frame, or explanations may omit important steps. These defects are difficult to fix because the video does not directly identify the required code changes. Producing a usable animation therefore requires inspecting the output and revising the program based on the defects.
blocks.zh: 教育动画通过显示数学关系,几何构造,以及随时间推移而展开的过程,帮助解释抽象的STEM概念. 然而,手动制作这些动画需要专题知识和编程专门知识。 近期的作品使用语言模型为动画引擎如马尼姆编写程序,将其制作成视频(Chen等人,2025b; Ku等人,2025年 ). 这种方法提供了对公式,文本,和几何的精确控制,在像素-空间视频生成时难以维护. 一个成功的渲染仍然可以产生一个糟糕的教学视频:标签可能重叠,对象可能掉到帧外,或者解释可能省略重要的步骤. 这些缺陷难以修复,因为视频没有直接识别所需的代码更改. 因此,制作一个可用的动画需要检查输出,并根据缺陷修订程序。

blocks.en: Agentic systems such as Code2Video ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , TheoremExplainAgent ( Ku et al., 2025 ) , and ManimAgent ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) use execution errors and, in some cases, visual feedback to revise generated programs. These systems typically rely on large models, often proprietary, and their refinement loops become much less reliable with smaller open alternatives. Specialized training is also limited by the available data. ManimBench ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026a ) contains render-verified programs but is relatively small, while community datasets and JanusCode-800K ( Sun et al., 2026 ) lack systematic rendering and quality checks. Of the 20,976 Hugging Face community programs we collected, roughly one-third fail to render as released. Even among the renderable Hugging Face programs, only 31% pass our quality criterion after revision. These datasets retain final programs but discard the errors, feedback, and edits that led to them. ManimTrainer ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026b ) uses reference-based rewards during training and execution feedback at inference, but does not directly supervise models to interpret and correct visual defects. Existing data therefore offers little guidance on how a model should review and revise its own animations.
blocks.zh: 代理系统如Code2Video(Chen等人,2025b),定理ExplainAgent(Ku等人,2025年),ManimAgent(Jiang等人,2026年)使用执行错误,在某些情况下使用视觉反馈来修改生成的程序. 这些系统通常依赖大型模型,常常是专有的,其完善的循环随着较小的开放替代品而变得更加不可靠. 专门培训也受到现有数据的限制。 Manim Bench(Rammuni Silva等人,2026年a)载有经过验证的程序,但相对较少,而社区数据集和JanusCode-800K(Sun等人,2026年)缺乏系统的渲染和质量检查。 我们收集的20 976个Hugging Face社区节目中, 大约三分之一的节目没有公布。 即使在可改装的"拥抱面部"节目中,只有31%在修改后通过了质量标准. 这些数据集保留了最终程序,但丢弃了导致它们的错误,反馈和编辑. 马尼姆训练员 (Rammuni Silva等人,2026b)在培训和执行反馈时使用基于参考的奖励推论,但不直接监督模型解释和纠正视觉缺陷. 因此,关于模型应如何审查和修订自己的动画,现有数据几乎没有提供指导。

blocks.en: To make feedback-driven refinement learnable by small open models, we build ManimData through a render-guided pipeline that records how animation programs are corrected and improved. We collect Manim programs from public datasets and generate additional requests from Wikipedia STEM topics. A strong open multimodal model then writes or revises each program, executes it, and reviews the rendered frames. Execution errors, layout checks, and visual critiques guide subsequent revisions, with relevant API documentation retrieved from a knowledge base covering Manim and eight domain plugins. The pipeline keeps the best version and admits a record only when it meets the quality criterion. The resulting 24,034 render-verified, quality-filtered records contain the final program and video, intermediate versions, errors, rendered frames, reviews, and revisions, preserving the feedback and corrective actions missing from existing Manim corpora.
blocks.zh: 为了让反馈驱动的改进能通过小型开放模型学习,我们通过一个渲染导线来构建ManimData,记录动画程序是如何被修正和改进的. 我们从公共数据集收集马尼姆程序,并从维基百科STEM专题生成额外请求. 一个强大的开放的多式联运模式然后写或修改每个程序,执行它,并审查已实现的框架。 执行错误、排版检查和视觉批评为随后的修订提供指导,从涵盖Manim和8个域插件的知识库中获取相关API文件。 管道保存最好的版本,只有在符合质量标准时才承认记录. 由此产生的24 034份经过核证、质量过滤的记录中包含最后的程序和录像、中间版本、错误、变帧、审查和订正,保留了现有的Manim Corpora中缺失的反馈和纠正行动。

blocks.en: We use ManimData to train ManimCode , enabling a single 4B model to write, review, and revise animation programs. We first organize the recorded trajectories into role-conditioned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) tasks. The Writer generates programs from requests and retrieved API documentation, the Reviewer assesses rendered frames and identifies visual defects, and the Reviser corrects execution failures and improves programs based on visual critiques. Training on final programs and intermediate correction steps improves initial generation and feedback-driven revision. Because the trajectories come from a stronger model, they may not fully capture errors encountered by the smaller model. We address this gap by training the Reviser with reinforcement learning (RL) on self-generated repair and critique states, using rendering outcomes and reference-free quality feedback as rewards. At inference, a single 4B model runs the complete render–review–revise loop without the larger model.
blocks.zh: 我们用ManimData来训练ManimCode, 我们首先将录制的轨迹编成角色条件监督微调任务。 Writer通过请求生成程序并检索API文档,审查者评估提供了帧并识别了视觉缺陷,修订者根据视觉批评来纠正执行失败并改进程序. 关于最后方案和中间矫正步骤的培训改善了初始生成和反馈驱动的修订。 由于轨迹来自较强的模型,它们可能无法完全捕捉较小模型遇到的错误. 我们通过对审校进行强化学习(RL)培训来弥补这一差距,培训内容是自我生成的修复和批评状态,利用成果和无参考质量反馈作为奖励。 推论,一个单一的4B模型运行的是完全渲染的–review–revise循环,而没有更大的模型.

blocks.en: We evaluate ManimCode on two scene-level animation benchmarks and integrate it as the scene generator in two long-form systems, Code2Video and TheoremExplainAgent. It achieves 96.6% and 97.0% render success on ManimData-test and ManimBench, compared with 52.6% and 82.0% for the untrained 4B backbone under the same inference setup. With the planning and rendering budgets held constant, completed videos increase from 19/117 to 107/117 and from 53/239 to 239/239, respectively, alongside improvements in learning-gain and visual-quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个场景级动画基准上评价ManimCode,并将其作为场景生成器整合到两个长形系统,即Code2Video和定理解释代理. 它在ManimData测试和Manim Bench上取得了96.6%和97.0%的成功,而在同样的推论设置下,未经培训的4B骨干则取得了52.6%和82.0%的成功。 随着规划和预算的保持,完成的录像分别从19/117增加到107/117和从53/239增加到239/239,同时改进了学习和视觉质量的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Feedback-Driven Code Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 反馈驱动代码生成

blocks.en: Language models can improve programs at inference time by critiquing and revising their own outputs ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) or by reading execution results ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2024 ) , although under matched sampling budgets such self-repair often gains little over resampling ( Olausson et al., 2024 ) . Later work trains these abilities directly. RLEF ( Gehring et al., 2024 ) and SCoRe ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) optimize multi-turn correction with reinforcement learning from execution feedback or final-answer correctness, while CriticGPT ( McAleese et al., 2024 ) and CTRL ( Xie et al., 2025 ) train critics that are rewarded for the bugs they catch or the fixes they enable. When a program’s output is visual, rendering supplies the feedback. Training corpora for chart, plotting, and user-interface code are filtered or repaired through execution ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , and reinforcement learning methods derive rewards for rendered outputs from their similarity to reference images ( Rodriguez et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , from a multimodal critic ( Li et al., 2025 ) , or from verifiable layout metrics ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our setting, WebLoop ( Meng et al., 2026 ) trains one policy to generate, critique, and refine web pages, and UI2Code N ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and VisRefiner ( Deng et al., 2026 ) train models to refine UI code from rendered screenshots. Most of these methods target static images or web pages, and most train only the generator or only the critic. In our setting, programs render videos whose defects unfold over time, usually with no reference to compare against, and one model learns to critique the rendered frames as well as to write and revise the program.
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以在推论时通过曲解和修改自己的产出(Madaan等人,2023年;Shinn等人,2023年)或通过阅读执行结果(Chen等人,2024年;Ding等人,2024年)来改进程序,尽管在相应的抽样预算下,这种自我修复往往比重新取样得很少(Olausson等人,2024年)。 后来的工作直接训练这些能力. RLEF(Gehring等人,2024年)和SCore(Kumar等人,2025年)优化了多转弯校正,从执行反馈或最终答案正确性中强化学习,而CriticGPT(McAlese等人,2024年)和CTRL(Xie等人,2025年)则对因捕捉到的虫子或它们所允许的修补而获得奖励的批评者进行培训. 当程序输出为可视化时, 渲染会提供反馈 。 通过执行对图、图和用户界面代码的培训进行过滤或修复(Zhao等人,2025年;Ni等人,2025年;Wu等人,2024年),强化学习方法从它们与参考图像的相似性(Rodriguez等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a),从多式联运评论家(Li等人,2025年),或从可核查的布局指标(Pan等人,2026年),获得对产出的奖励。 WebLoop(Meng等人, 2026年)训练一款生成、批评及精炼网页的政策, 这些方法大多针对静态图像或网页,大多数只训练生成器或只训练评论家. 在我们的设定中,程序制作的视频的缺陷会随着时间推移而发生,通常没有参照比对,有一个模型学会批评已提供的帧,以及写和修改程序.

blocks.en: 2.2  Code-Based Educational Animation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于密码的教育动画

blocks.en: Code-based generation is now a common route to precise educational animation. Agentic systems write Manim scenes with large, mostly proprietary language models ( Samarth et al., 2025 ) . Code2Video ( Chen et al., 2025b ) and TheoremExplainAgent ( Ku et al., 2025 ) plan long-form lectures and repair each scene’s code from render errors over several renders, and ManimAgent ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) guides the repairs with visual review of the rendered frames. OmniManim ( Li et al., 2026 ) adds a learned layout prior, SGA ( Lopez et al., 2026 ) checks scene geometry symbolically before rendering, and multi-agent systems such as SciEducator ( Xu et al., 2026 ) produce multimodal educational content from scientific videos. Benchmarks score generated Manim code on executability, request alignment, and visual similarity ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026a ; Oli, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于代码的生成现在是精确教育动画的通路. 代理系统用大型,多为专有的语言模型写出马尼姆场景(Samarth等人,2025年). 代码2Video(Chen等人,2025b)和定理解释代理商 (Ku等人,2025年)计划进行长式讲座,并修复每个场景的代码,避免在几个场景上产生错误,ManimAgent(Jiang等人,2026年)指导修复工作,对已造框进行直观审查。 OmniManim(Li et al., 2026)在渲染前增加了一个学习过的布局,SGA(Lopez et al., 2026)在渲染前象征性地检查场景几何,SciEducator(Xu et al., 2026)等多剂系统从科学视频中产生多模式教育内容. 基准分数产生了关于可执行性、请求对齐性和视觉相似性的Manim代码(Rammuni Silva等人,2026a;Oli,2026)。

blocks.en: Training-based work is sparse. JanusCoder ( Sun et al., 2026 ) includes Manim programs in a large corpus of visual code. ManimTrainer ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026b ) follows fine-tuning with reinforcement learning that rewards similarity to reference programs and videos, and at inference it re-prompts the model with render errors and retrieved documentation. SimuScene ( Wang et al., 2026 ) rewards physics animations with a vision-language model that answers verification questions about the rendered video. Each of these trains a model to write a complete program, and feedback enters only as a training reward or as error messages at inference. ManimData instead records how programs were reviewed and revised, so our model learns these steps as well.
blocks.zh: 基于培训的工作很少。 Janus Coder(Sun等人,2026年)将Manim程序包含在大量视觉码中. 马尼姆训练员 校对:Soup SimuScene(Wang等人,2026年)以视觉语言模型奖励物理动画,该模型回答关于渲染视频的验证问题. 每个都训练一个模型来写一个完整的程序,反馈输入时只作为训练奖励或推断错误信息. ManimData则记录了如何审查和修订方案,因此我们的模型也学习了这些步骤。

blocks.en: 3  Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: ManimData pairs each request with a render-verified program, its video, and the trajectory of errors, critiques, and revisions that produced the program. It draws on two sources: requests derived from Wikipedia STEM topics and public community programs (Sec. 3.1 ). A single render-guided pipeline writes, renders, checks, reviews, and revises the programs from both sources with retrieved API documentation (Sec. 3.2 , Fig. 1 ). Table 1 compares ManimData with existing Manim datasets and benchmarks.

blocks.en: 3.1  Data Sources and API Knowledge Base
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源和API知识库

blocks.en: Wikipedia requests. We derive requests from 639,700 English Wikipedia articles. A coarse-to-fine filter with Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) keeps 15,159 topics whose central ideas can be shown graphically. Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) finds directly drawable content in 12,516 of these topics, assigns each of them one of 30 visualization types, and writes up to two open-ended requests per topic specifying what to draw and emphasize. blocks.en: 4  Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: ManimCode learns from both the final programs and the intermediate corrections in ManimData’s render–review–revise trajectories. Role-conditioned trajectory supervision trains a 4B model to write programs, assess rendered outputs, and correct execution and visual defects. Because a stronger model collected these trajectories, we further train the Reviser with reinforcement learning on failures generated by the supervised model. At inference, the model iteratively refines educational animations within a fixed rendering budget.

blocks.en: 4.1  Role-Conditioned Trajectory Supervision
blocks.zh: 4.1 角色-有条件的轨迹监督

blocks.en: We use each trajectory to supervise the model’s writing, reviewing, and revision steps. Every example is a triple ( ρ , z , y ) (\rho,z,y) : role ρ \rho , context z z , and target y y . The Writer receives the request and retrieved API cards and targets the trajectory’s final program c ∗ c^{*} , so it learns from the refinements made during construction. The Reviewer receives the request, current program, and sampled frames; its targets are the four recorded scores and the critique. For the Reviser , we extract two kinds of successful transitions: (i) execution repairs , revisions that turn a crashed program into one that renders, and (ii) quality revisions , critique-driven revisions for which the mean review score exceeds that of the program being revised. The Reviser targets the complete revised program given the request, program being revised, error or critique, layout diagnostics when available, and API cards. We also supervise retrieval queries based on the request and, when available, the error or critique, so the model can retrieve API cards at inference.

blocks.en: 5  Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate ManimCode with three research questions. RQ1: How does ManimCode perform compared with existing general-purpose and Manim-specialized models on scene-level animation generation? RQ2: Can ManimCode improve long-form educational video generation when integrated into existing systems? RQ3: How do ManimData, trajectory supervision, and Reviser RL contribute to generation performance? We further analyze representative revision examples and examine the agreement between automatic quality assessments and human preferences.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个研究问题来评价ManimCode. RQ1:在场景级动画生成上,ManimCode与现有的通用模型和Manim专业模型相比如何表现? RQ2: 马尼姆 代码在融入现有系统时改善长式教育视频生成? RQ3:ManimData,轨迹监督,以及审校RL如何促进生成性能? 我们进一步分析有代表性的修订实例,审查自动质量评估与人类偏好之间的协议。

blocks.en: We evaluate scene generation on two test sets. ManimData-test consists of 500 requests selected from the ManimData request pool, 219 Wikipedia requests and 281 community requests, all excluded from training (Appendix A.1 ). ManimBench ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026a ) has 100 test requests with reference programs, and we follow its protocol. Of the 100 references, 85 nearly duplicate ManimCE documentation examples that our knowledge base contains, so in all our ManimBench runs the retriever excludes those examples. For long-form generation we use MMMC , the 117 lecture topics of Code2Video ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , and TheoremExplainBench (TEB), the 239 distinct theorems of TheoremExplainAgent ( Ku et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: The general-purpose baselines served through APIs are GPT-4o ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) and two recent mixture-of-experts models, GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek-V4 Flash, which we query through OpenRouter 1 1 1 https://openrouter.ai/ . The open general-purpose baselines that we run locally are Qwen3.5-4B (our base model), Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.8-27B. The Manim-specialized baselines are JanusCoder-8B ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , whose training data contains most ManimBench test requests ( † in Table 2 ), and the released Seed-Coder-8B checkpoint of ManimTrainer ( Rammuni Silva et al., 2026b ) . blocks.en: For scene-level evaluation, we report render success (RS), visual similarity (VS), and video quality (VQ). RS measures the percentage of successfully rendered programs. blocks.en:
To assess the reliability of our automatic quality judge, we conduct a human evaluation on 98 pairs of videos generated by ManimCode and GPT-4o or Qwen3.8-27B. A blinded annotator selects the video better suited for teaching or marks a tie (Appendix C.4 ).
Human preferences show stronger agreement with the judge when quality differences are larger: for VQ gaps of at least 0.5, the annotator agrees with the judge on 79% of decided pairs, compared with only 29% for gaps below 0.25. At the system level, human preferences align with the judge’s rankings in three of four comparisons (Table 11 ), favoring ManimCode over GPT-4o overall but Qwen3.8-27B on ManimData-test. The judge appears useful for assessing video quality, especially when the VQ gap is larger.

blocks.en: In Figure 5 , our Reviewer locates a layout defect in the rendered frames, the Reviser turns its critique into a small code edit, and the judge, which plays no part in the loop, also scores the revised video higher. Revisions can also fail. In one example of Appendix C.5 , the first of two consecutive revisions moves a list down to clear a progress bar but pushes it past the bottom edge, and the second moves it back up and restores the overlap. The Reviewer scores the second revision lower, so the loop keeps the first as its best candidate even though its list is still cut off. Keeping the best-scored candidate stops a regression from replacing a better version, but it cannot repair a defect that the Reviser leaves behind.

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: ManimData and ManimCode provide a data and training framework for feedback-driven educational animation generation. ManimData contains 24,034 render-verified, quality-filtered records that retain final programs alongside execution errors, visual critiques, and corrective revisions. ManimCode uses role-conditioned supervision and reinforcement learning on self-generated revision states to train a 4B model to write, review, and revise animation programs. It achieves 96.6% and 97.0% render success on ManimData-test and ManimBench, respectively, while maintaining competitive video quality against larger general-purpose models. When integrated into Code2Video and TheoremExplainAgent, ManimCode also improves long-form video completion and visual quality scores.
blocks.zh: 马尼姆达塔和马尼姆 代码为反馈驱动的教育动画制作提供了数据和培训框架. 马尼姆 数据包含24,034个经校验的、经过质量过滤的记录,这些记录保留了最后的程序,同时保留了执行错误、视觉批评和修正。 马尼姆 代码在自产生修订状态上使用角色有条件的监督和强化学习来训练一个4B模型来编写,审查和修订动画程序. 它分别实现了96.6%和97.0%的ManimData测试和Manim Bench测试成功,同时保持了较大型通用模型具有竞争力的视频质量。 当整合到Code2Video和定理ExplainAgent中时,ManimCode还改进了长式视频完成和视觉质量分数.

blocks.en: We extract five types of examples from the 24,034 ManimData trajectories (Table 8 ). A writing example pairs the request and its retrieved API cards with the final program of the record. Community records lack a Writer step because their first version is released code. To reconstruct the Writer input, Qwen3.8-27B writes retrieval queries for the request, and the top 10 retrieved cards form the context. An execution-repair example keeps a revision that turns a crashing program into one that renders. A quality-revision example keeps a revision whose mean Reviewer score is higher than that of the program it revised. We subsample reviewing examples from the recorded reviews, with at most two per community record. Retrieval-query examples pair Qwen3.8-27B’s queries with the request and any error or critique.
blocks.zh: 我们从24,034 ManimData轨迹中提取了5种例子(表8)。 一个写作示例将请求及其检索到的API卡与记录的最终程序对齐. 社区记录缺乏Writer步骤,因为他们的第一个版本是发布代码. 为了重建 Writer 输入, Quen3. 8- 27B 为请求写回检索查询, 前10张检索卡构成上下文. 一个执行- 修复的例子保存一个修改, 将崩溃程序变成一个使程序产生效果的程序 。 一个质量修正的例子保留着一个修正,其平均审校分高于其订正的方案。 我们抽样审查记录审查中的例子,每个社区的记录最多有两个。 检索- query 实例将 Quen3. 8- 27B 的询问与请求和任何错误或批评 。

blocks.en: C.1  Baselines and Model Versions

blocks.en: Single-pass baselines decode at temperature 0.4 and top- p p 0.95 with at most 8,192 new tokens; thinking is disabled for models that support it. On ManimData-test they receive our Writer’s system prompt without retrieved API cards; on ManimBench they receive the benchmark’s own prompt. GPT-4o is the snapshot gpt-4o-2024-11-20 . GLM-5.3 Flash ( z-ai/glm-5.3-flash ) and DeepSeek-V4 Flash ( deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash ) are queried through OpenRouter in November 2026 with the same sampling settings, pinned to the official Z.AI endpoint (fp8) for GLM-5.3 Flash and to DeepInfra (fp8) for DeepSeek-V4 Flash, with Fireworks as the only allowed alternative; Fireworks served 15 of the 600 DeepSeek-V4 Flash requests. That model is not released, and the authors used ManimCE 0.19.0; we use 0.19.1.

blocks.en: C.2  Judge
blocks.zh: C.2 法官

blocks.en: The judge is Gemini 3.8 Flash (API model models/gemini-3.8-flash ). It sees the request and the rendered video at 2 frames per second, but not the code. One call assigns 1–5 scores for request alignment, content completeness, and semantic correctness; their mean is Q cont Q_{\mathrm{cont}} . A dedicated presentation prompt scores visual clarity and animation quality in two calls; Q pres Q_{\mathrm{pres}} is the mean of the calls’ averages. VQ is the mean of Q cont Q_{\mathrm{cont}} and Q pres Q_{\mathrm{pres}} . The scene-level scores in each table come from one batch run in October 2026, except the GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek-V4 Flash rows of Table 2 , which were scored on November 1, 2026. For that later batch, we re-scored 30 ManimData-test and 30 ManimBench anchor videos from October; their mean VQ changed by + 0.03 +0.03 and − 0.02 -0.02 .

blocks.en: C.3  Long-Form Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.3 长期评价

blocks.en: For each long-form system, both runs use a lecture plan written by the untrained Qwen3.5-4B in that system’s native configuration; they differ only in the scene generator. The native run uses that model to write and repair each scene, while our run uses ManimCode. Each run gets at most 10 renders per section or scene, and sections that never render are skipped when the video is merged. We replace each benchmark’s original judge with Gemini 3.8 Flash, so absolute scores are not comparable with published numbers.
blocks.zh: 每个长形系统都使用未经训练的Quen3.5-4B在系统本土配置中编写的讲座计划;它们只在场景生成器上有所不同。 原生跑步使用该模型来编写和修复每个场景,而我们的跑步则使用ManimCode. 每次运行每节或场景得到最多10分,在视频合并后从未渲染的段落会被跳过. 我们用双子座3.8 Flash取代每个基准的原判,因此绝对分数与公布的数字不相上下。

blocks.en: For MMMC we report the number of completed videos, the TeachQuiz learning gain ( × \times 100) over all 117 topics, and the aesthetics score (0–100) over the produced videos; a topic without a video counts as zero TeachQuiz gain. The 4B planner produces no valid plan for 10 of the 117 topics, so our 107 videos cover every topic that has a plan. TheoremExplainBench (TEB) has 239 distinct theorems; its list of 240 contains The Ideal Gas Law twice. Its visual score is the geometric mean (1–5) of three visual dimensions (visual relevance, element layout, and visual consistency) over the produced videos, judged with the audio removed; an all-black video scores 1 on the two frame-based dimensions. We omit the two narration-based dimensions of TEB because they score the shared plan. For 10 theorems, the native run never saved the implementation plans of some scenes (23 of the 1,371), and our run re-planned these scenes with the same untrained 4B model.
blocks.zh: 对MMMC来说,我们报告完成的视频数量,TeachQuiz学习增益(×\times 100)覆盖所有117个话题,美学评分(0–100)覆盖制作的视频;没有视频的话题算作零TeachQuiz增益. 4B计划者没有为117个话题中的10个给出有效的计划,因此我们的107个视频涵盖了每个有计划的主题. 定理解释本奇(TEB)有239个不同的定理;它的240个清单两次包含"理想气体法". 它的视觉分数是三个视觉维度(视觉相关性,元素布局和视觉一致性)的几何平均值(1-5),相对于制作的视频,用删除的音频来判断;一个全黑视频在两个帧基维度上得分1分. 我们省略了TEB的两个以叙述为基础的维度,因为它们得分了共同计划. 对于10个定理,土生土长的奔跑从未拯救过一些场景的执行计划(1,371人中的23人),我们跑用相同的未经训练的4B型号重新规划了这些场景.

blocks.en: C.4  Human Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.4 人的评价议定书

blocks.en: We sampled at random (with a fixed seed) 98 requests that both our system and its opponent rendered: 48 against GPT-4o (31 from ManimData-test and 17 from ManimBench) and 50 against Qwen3.8-27B (36 and 14); no request was used for both opponents. The videos are the files scored in Table 2 , so each human choice can be compared with the judge’s scores for the same two videos.
blocks.zh: 我们随机抽样(有固定种子)98请求我们的系统及其对手都给出:48对GPT-4o(31对ManimData-test和17对Manim Bench),50对Qune3.8-27B(36和14);没有为两个对手使用请求. 影片是表2中得分的文件,

blocks.en: Each page of the annotation interface shows the full request and the two silent videos side by side, labeled A and B in random order, without system names or scores. Both videos loop, and an answer is accepted only after each video has played for at least 90% of its length; dragging the scrubber to the end does not count. The annotator chooses the video they would rather show to students to explain the request (A, about the same, or B). They weigh whether the content is correct and covers the request, and whether everything is readable, inside the frame, and free of overlaps; the instructions state that a longer video is not better by itself. Pairs are shown in random order, and two of them reappear later as a consistency check; the repeats are excluded from all counts.
blocks.zh: 注释界面的每页都同时显示完整请求和两个无声视频,按随机顺序标注A和B,没有系统名称或分数. 两段视频循环,只有在每段视频播放至少90%的长度后才能接受答案;将擦拭器拖到结尾不算数. 注释者选择他们宁愿向学生展示的视频来解释请求(A,大约相同,或B). 他们权衡内容是否正确,是否覆盖了请求,以及是否一切都是可读的,在帧内,没有重叠;指令称更长的视频本身并不更好. 平面按随机顺序显示,其中两个后来作为一致性检查重新出现;重复被排除在所有计数中.

blocks.en: One member of our team, who did not know which system produced which video, judged all 98 pairs, taking a median of 24 seconds per pair. Table 10 splits the choices by the judge’s VQ gap, and Table 11 compares the human and judge verdicts per opponent and benchmark. Among pairs in which both the annotator and the judge picked a side, the annotator agreed with the judge’s content ordering in 69% and with its presentation ordering in 65%. Neither the annotator nor the judge showed a detectable preference for longer videos. Regressing the annotator’s verdict (our video preferred = 1 =1 , about the same = 0.5 =0.5 , the opponent’s preferred = 0 =0 ) on the log 2 \log_{2} ratio of the two video lengths, with opponent-by-benchmark fixed effects, gives a slope of 0.03 per doubling (95% CI − 0.09 -0.09 to 0.13 0.13 ); the same fit on the judge’s verdicts gives 0.05 ( − 0.08 -0.08 to 0.16 0.16 ). All intervals are percentile bootstrap intervals over pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们团队的一名成员不知道哪个系统制作了哪个视频,他对所有98对视频进行了判断,每对视频中位数为24秒。 表10按照法官的VQ差距来划分选择,表11比较了每个对手和基准的人与法官的判决. 在书记官和法官都选择了一方的对子中,书记官同意法官69%的内容命令,65%的内容命令。 注释员和法官都没有表现出对更长视频的明显偏好。 复述注释员的判决(我们的视频偏好=1=1,大约相同=0.5=0.5,对手偏好=0=0=0)在log 2\log_{2}两个视频长度的比例上,加上对手逐个基准的固定效果,给出了每双倍0.03的斜率(95%的CI−0.09-009至0.130.13);同样适合法官的判决给出0.05(−0.08-008至0.160.16). 所有间隔都是百分位的靴子间隔。

blocks.en: Table 10: Human choices by VQ gap. The gap is the absolute difference between the VQ scores that the judge (Gemini) gave the two videos of a pair (98 pairs, one annotator). Among pairs in which both the annotator and the judge chose a side, agreement is the share in which the annotator picked the video the judge scored higher (95% bootstrap interval in brackets). In the 14 pairs with equal judge scores, the annotator answered about the same in 6 and chose a side in 8; in the All row, those 8 count only in the Pairs column.
blocks.zh: 表10:按VQ差距分列的人类选择。 差距是法官(Gemini)给一对(98对,1个注释员)的两个视频的VQ分数的绝对差异. 在注释员和法官都选择一方的对子中,协议是注释员选择法官得分较高的视频(括号内95%的靴子间隔)的份额。 在评委分数相等的14对中,注释员在6分中回答大致相同,在8分中选择了一方;在全行中,这8分只计算在平分栏中.

blocks.en: Table 11: Human and judge (Gemini) verdicts on the same pairs. Wins, ties, and losses of our system against each opponent; for the judge, a tie means equal VQ scores. The human win rate counts a tie as half (95% bootstrap interval in brackets).
blocks.zh: 表11:人类和法官(Gemini)对同一对的判决。 我们的系统对每个对手的胜负,联系和损失;对裁判来说,平分意味着VQ的分数相等. 人类赢率计算为平局的一半(括号内为95%的靴子间隔)。

blocks.en: C.5  Qualitative Revision Examples
blocks.zh: C.5 定性修订

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows five more revision steps from our system on ManimData-test, in the same format as Figure 5 . We automatically drew candidate steps from the evaluation run by edit type: crash repair, layout repair, content correction, and revisions that our Reviewer scored lower. We re-rendered both versions of each candidate for the judge, then kept steps whose defect was visible in a sampled frame. When both versions had a score, the judge’s score moved in the same direction as our Reviewer’s, except for the content correction, which the judge scored 3.00 before and after.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了我们系统在ManimData-test上的另外五个修订步骤,其格式与图5相同。 我们从按编辑类型进行的评审中自动绘制候选步骤:崩溃修复,布局修复,内容校正,以及我们评论员得分较低的修改. 我们重新交代了每个法官候选人的两种版本,然后保留了在抽样框架中明显缺陷的台阶。 两个版本都有分数时,法官的分数与我们的审校相同,但内容校正除外,法官前后得分3.

blocks.en: Figure 6: More revision steps of our system on ManimData-test. Each row is one revision step; the best-candidate rule decides which version the loop returns. From the top: a crash repaired from the renderer’s error message; a wrong sum corrected in the explanation text; an overlap removed by moving the result below the derivation; and two consecutive revisions of the same request. In the last two rows, moving the transaction list down clears the progress bar but pushes the list past the bottom edge, and moving it back up restores the overlap; our Reviewer scores the second revision lower, so the loop keeps the first. Under each frame are our Reviewer’s mean score and the score that the judge, Gemini 3.8 Flash, gives the re-rendered video (1–5).
blocks.zh: 图6:我们系统关于ManimData测试的更多修订步骤。 每行都是一个修订步骤;最优的指定规则决定循环返回的哪个版本. 从顶部:从渲染器的错误消息中修复一个崩溃;在解释文本中更正了一个错误的总和;通过将结果移到衍生物下面来消除一个重叠;以及连续两次修改同一请求. 在最后两行中,将交易列表向下移动可以清除进度栏,但将列表推过下边缘,向上移动可以恢复重叠;我们的审阅员将第二修订版评分更低,因此循环保持第一. 每个框架下都是我们评论员的中分和评委双子座3.8 Flash给重播视频(1–5)的分数.
